title: Rav Acha of Hutzal
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He lived in Rav Ashi’s time, as in [Keritot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.13b.14): he had made a vow concerning his wife and came to Rav Ashi to release it; Rav Ashi told him, “Go now and come tomorrow,” etc. In [Beitzah 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Beitzah.32b.12) Ravina said to Rav Ashi: “Rav Acha of Hutzal told us that they plaster an oven for the Master on a festival,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: In Keritot, Rav Ashi tells Rav Acha to return the next day. In Beitzah, Ravina relays Rav Acha’s report to Rav Ashi about the oven used for the Master.
